mission.title: Decapitation
mission.description: Track down the Colonel, the leader of the commandos.

npc.say: Come see me anytime, {player}. Nothing like a nice, leisurely chat while you're on R&R.

phase.briefing:
The data you obtained for us has been decrypted and analyzed. The nature of the data, and its structure, are most... intriguing. They are almost... machine-like in their precision and efficiency.
Regardless, our analysts have narrowed down the probable location of the Colonel. A few more investigative steps, and he shall be yours to dispose of, {player}.

enter.say: From what Gray's said, I think we're getting close! Have a look around in here, and don't spare the bodies.

objective.text: Get the tracer from the Commando Lieutenant

done.say: That tracer looks promising. Exit the area and we'll see where it points us.

phase.briefing:
These commandos initially seemed to be very precise and efficient. They obviously have their own shortcomings, however. Their thoughts seem to run in a straight line, easily intercepted.
Proceed to the location indicated by the tracer. Take all necessary actions.

enter.say: Gray's right... it's almost like these commandos are just relying on brute strength, and it isn't paying off. Have a look around in here.

done.say: A data CD... okay, I need you to get that to a hardline. I have a good feeling about this.

objective.text: Upload the data CD at a hardline

phase.briefing:
The data has been received, and the Colonel's coordinates decrypted. This is the last sloppy mistake he will make.
Proceed to the indicated location. Eliminate the Colonel.

enter.say: Looks like we've got the Colonel cornered, {player}. I'm reading a signal that's gotta be him... plus some sort of strange broadcast. I'm sure we'll figure that one out once you get in there.

talk.say:
So, it's you {player}. I've heard so much about you. Before you kill me, there is something you should know.
Have your operator scan channel 437. That's right, 437, the Machines' physical facilities channel. Have him take a look at sector 17. Ask him to compare the broadcast signal there, and the one coming from my own RSI. Don't worry, take your time.

done.say:
Channel 437... sector 17... that covers a huge chunk of the bluepill pods. Wait, what's that -- some sort of broadcast signal? It seems familiar somehow... something from back in the war...
Oh no. That signal's coming from an explosive device, positioned to take out a whole section of pods! And it looks like our friend the Colonel has a matching signal coming from his RSI... if we kill him, chances are the device will blow. I don't know how many bluepills will be slaughtered in their pods... we're gonna have to call this operation off, {player}.

mission.finish:
...
I... this situation will be addressed, {player}. Rest assured.
